assessment: This study sought to systematically identify key aspects of the transcriptional landscape in fungi that exhibit complex multicellularity (CM), associated with fruiting bodies. The authors examined a series of parameters of expression signatures, concluding that the best predictor of a gene behavior in the CM transcriptome was evolutionary age. Thus, the expression pattern of fruiting bodies showed a distinct gene age-related stratification, where it was possible to sort out genes related to general sexual processes from those likely linked to morphogenetic aspects of the CM fruiting bodies. Notably, these results do not support a developmental hourglass concept, which is the rather predominant hypothesis in metazoans, including some analysis in fungi.
